quarterly_data.quarter: GE Vernova press release: GE Vernova advances asset longevity for Egypt's power (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GE Vernova (Gas Power) announced a services agreement to provide Rotor Life Extension (RLE) solutions for five GE Vernova 9F gas turbines at the Kureimat, Nubaria and Cairo North power plants in Egypt. The agreement is with affiliates of the Egyptian Electricity Holding Company (EEHC) - Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company (UEEPC), Middle Delta Electricity Production Company (MDEPC) and Cairo Electricity Production Company (CEPC) - and was endorsed by EEHC. GE Vernova is expected to help extend the operating life of the five turbines, representing a total capacity of approximately 1,250 MW, by 13 to 15 years; the services will be executed between 2028 and 2035. It builds on an order from MDEPC announced in April 2026 for modernization at the Banha and Nubaria plants (Advanced Gas Path upgrades and multiyear services agreements). GE Vernova's installed base in Egypt includes more than 60 gas and steam turbines with approximately 10 gigawatts of combined generating capacity. No contract value stated.
quarterly_data.figure: five 9F gas turbines, approximately 1,250 MW; life extended 13 to 15 years; services executed between 2028 and 2035
